theme: An open day, then a late flight north.
greeting: Morning, Dan — the calendar is empty until a 10:15 PM flight from Reagan up to Bangor. Two things want you before you fly, and the girls are with Jen.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time for the PRI call
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia wrote back in your PRI thread with times next week — Monday midday or a couple of Thursday windows, your time — and is waiting on you to choose one.

needsAttention.title: Clear Mike's calendar for surgery
needsAttention.detail: Today is the deadline on your oral-surgery prep task to block Mike's work calendar for Aug 20–21, the surgery in Portland and the recovery day after.

flagged.title: Eugenia wants to schedule the PRI call
flagged.detail: Networking reply offering Monday or Thursday windows next week; awaiting your pick.

inbox.noise: Newsletters and promotions were quiet overnight.
inbox.clear: No security, account, or financial mail — one networking reply flagged above.

resolved: You replied to Drew this morning after Schwartzman's overnight trip to the emergency vet.

recipe.title: The splendid summer tomato sandwich
recipe.why: August tomatoes are at their peak and ask for almost nothing — a fitting, no-cook supper for a travel day that lands you in Maine close to midnight.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
